resumeLine: Optimized a nightly reconciliation job from 45 minutes to 6 minutes by batching writes.

claims.quote: nightly reconciliation job from 45 minutes to 6 minutes

answers.text: We batched writes at five hundred rows and dropped an index that was being maintained on every insert. Those two together took it from forty-five minutes to six.
We made it faster by batching.
Some optimisation work, the usual things.
A failed batch is caught, printed and skipped, and the job still returns zero — so a partial reconciliation looks like a successful one to whatever is watching it.
Failures are logged so we can look at them.

seededDefects.description: A failed batch is logged and skipped, and the job still exits 0, so a partial reconciliation reports success.
The 45-to-6-minute claim has no measurement in the code; batch size is hardcoded with no recorded basis.
